title: Normalized findings document (findings/v1)
description: The platform-neutral form of a scanner's findings: what a platform adapter (scripts/aws-findings-adapter.py for AWS) writes and the VDR build reads with --findings. Nothing downstream of it depends on the platform. The VDR build checks every rule here itself (scripts/build-vdr-report.py, ingest_findings) and refuses a document that breaks one; this file states them for an adapter's author. Fields the build computes (first detection, PAIN, deadlines, decisions) are not accepted from an adapter.

platform.description: Where the findings come from, e.g. aws.

adapter.description: The script that wrote this document.

source.description: The scanner. A source in VULN_SOURCES (build-vdr-report.py, vuln-gate.py) is decided by a register record naming its cve or tracking_id; any other source is decided as a configuration finding, by its tool_id.

tool_id.description: The scanner's rule or vulnerability ID.

tracking_id.description: Stable for one finding on one resource across runs: the first-detected ledger keys on it.

resource.description: What the finding is about, with any cloud account ID masked; the build resolves it to an inventoried component.

detected_at.description: When the scanner first observed it (ISO 8601).
